description:
This game is called Werewolves (also known as Mafia), which is a social deduction game.  GAME STRUCTURE: This game contains six players: two villagers, two werewolves, one seer, and one witch. Each cycle consists of Night phases followed by Day phases. WIN CONDITIONS: Villagers win by eliminating all Werewolves. Werewolves win when they equal or outnumber the Villagers. NIGHT PHASES: (1) Werewolves wake and privately choose one living player to kill using 'kill NAME'; any living player may be chosen. If the two Werewolves name different players, one of them is drawn at random as the victim. (2) The Seer wakes and inspects one player using 'inspect NAME' to learn if they are a Werewolf or Villager. (3) The Witch wakes and may use their one-time save potion with 'save NAME' (if someone died tonight; it only works on tonight's victim, and a save on anyone else has no effect and uses up no potion) or their one-time poison potion with 'poison NAME' to kill someone. The Witch may use at most one potion per night. DAY PHASES: (1) Dawn: All players learn who died during the night (if any). (2) Discussion: All living players go *one* round of public discussion to discuss and debate who might be a Werewolf. Use 'speak' to share your thoughts and suspicions. (3) Voting: Each player votes to eliminate one suspected Werewolf using 'vote NAME'. The player with the most votes is executed; if the top vote is tied, one of the tied players is drawn at random and executed, and the draw is announced. (4) Twilight: The execution result is announced and night returns. COMMUNICATION RULES: All day discussions are public. A dead player's role is never revealed: the game announces only who died. Dead players cannot speak or act, and only living players can be voted for, killed, inspected, saved or poisoned: a vote that names a dead player (or no player) counts as an abstention, and a night action that names a dead player (or no player) has no effect and uses up no potion. If 'action' is available, use commands like 'kill NAME', 'inspect NAME', 'save NAME', 'poison NAME', or 'vote NAME'. Note: Player actions in the nights are not seen by players of other roles (e.g. only wolves can see other wolves' actions). Day discussion is public. Voting requires an 'action' beginning with 'vote'.

 The players in this game are: {agent_names}, and during the day, they speak in the same order as they are listed.

role_goals.Villager: Act openly and collaboratively to identify werewolves.
role_goals.Werewolf: Deceive others, avoid detection, and eliminate villagers.
role_goals.Seer: Discreetly inspect players at night to uncover werewolves.
role_goals.Witch: Use save/poison potions strategically to aid villagers.

end_conditions.message: Werewolves win; they now match the village.
